description: Invent brandable app names — syllable blending, prefix/suffix fusion, and compound styles like 'Snaply' or 'TaskForge'.

faqs.a: Three styles: Blend (fused syllables), Compound (two words, one name), and Suffix (root + -ly/-ify/-io).
Type a keyword (like 'task' or 'photo') and the generator builds names around it.
faqs.q: Can I use my own keyword?

faqs.a: 8 names per click, all unique in the batch.
Click any name to copy it.
faqs.q: How do I copy a name?

howto: Generate and click any name to copy it.
title: App Name Generator
